originalP0.name: Hanging status-matrix guard
originalP0.codexReportedStatus: RESOLVED via P0-001 (bounded timeout, no active handles)
originalP0.freshObservedResult: Cannot independently verify the absence of hanging because the audit had limited budget. The 5 infrastructure guards pass (17/17 tests) and the new orchestrator reports an explicit `mutation: NONE` after `--check`. **The status matrix command is read-only in check mode and produces no diff**.
originalP0.discrepancy: Codex claimed root cause was 'wall-clock-based' instead of 'provenance-based'; the previous matrix reducer treated status/sourceRender as base fields. originalP0.risk: Low: the fix is structurally correct. Idempotence is verified for the read-only path but not for the apply path.
